Standard second-order form  

G(s)=Kp /(τ²s²+2ζτs+1) with Kp=4, denominator 9s²+2.4s+1.  
Hence τ²=9 ⇒ τ=3 min, 2ζτ=2.4 ⇒ ζ=2.4/(2·3)=0.4.

a)  ζ = 0.40.

b)  Percent overshoot PO = exp[–πζ/√(1–ζ²)]·100  
   = exp[–π(0.4)/√0.84]·100 = 0.2536·100 ≈ 25.4 %.

c)  Natural frequency ωn =1/τ =1/3=0.333 rad min⁻¹  
    Damped frequency ωd = ωn√(1–ζ²)=0.333·0.9165=0.3055 rad min⁻¹  
    First-peak time Tp = π/ωd =3.14/0.3055 ≈10.3 min.

d)  Final change Δyss =Kp·Δu =4·2=8.  
    Peak value y′max =Δyss(1+PO/100)=8(1+0.2536)=10.03.

e)  Decay ratio DR = exp[–2πζ/√(1–ζ²)]  
   = exp[–2π(0.4)/√0.84] = exp(–2.743) ≈0.0646.

FINAL (a): 0.40 -
FINAL (b): 25.4 %
FINAL (c): 10.3 min
FINAL (d): 10.0 y′-units
FINAL (e): 0.0646 -
